results.summary: Pennant has delivered ahead of expectations with significant improvements across multiple metrics. Revenues grew 29% to £5.8m (H1 2025: £4.5m), gross margin improved substantially to 54% (from 44%), and the company swung from a £1.1m EBITDA loss to £0.5m profit. results.summary: The company issued a trading statement reporting expected earnings of 1.0-1.1 cents per share for H1 2026 versus a loss of 6.1 cents per share in the prior comparative period. While this represents a significant year-on-year improvement, the statement contains no comparison to market expectations, analyst forecasts, board guidance, or any forward-looking expectations. The company noted it adopts net asset value per share as its key performance measure rather than earnings. No guidance expectations are referenced.

results.headline: Arada Consent Solicitation Results Announcement
results.key_quote: Valid Electronic Voting Instructions voting in favour of the Extraordinary Resolution representing less than 75 per cent. in aggregate face amount of the Certificates outstanding were provided by Eligible Certificateholders to the Information and Tabulation Agent as at both the Consent Fee Deadline and the Expiration Deadline.
results.summary: This is a consent solicitation results announcement regarding a debt restructuring. The announcement reports that the consent solicitation to modify the terms of U.S.$500,000,000 Trust Certificates due 2027 did not achieve the required 75% threshold for approval. No operating performance metrics, financial results, or expectations are disclosed. The announcement is purely procedural in nature regarding a failed debt modification attempt.

This is a transactional/procedural update, not an earnings or trading update.

results.headline: Genel Energy PLC: Statement regarding offer f...
results.key_quote: Following the DNO Offer, Genel is considering its position and a further announcement will be made when appropriate.
results.summary: This is a regulatory announcement regarding a competing takeover offer for Capricorn Energy plc. Genel Energy had announced its own offer for Capricorn on 2 July 2026, but received a competing offer from DNO ASA on 1 September 2026. The announcement contains no financial results, operational metrics, or performance comparisons to expectations. Genel states it is considering its position pending further announcements. No guidance, forecasts, or performance metrics are provided in this statement.
